title: Mobile Crash Report Sync
transcript:
Marcus: Hey team, Crashlytics is lighting up with SIGSEGV errors on iOS 18.
Priya: Yeah I saw that in the triage channel. I can take that one. I will push an iOS crash hotfix by tomorrow morning.
Marcus: Legend, thank you Priya.
Alex Chen: Should we roll back the last release?
Priya: No need, it's just a nil pointer in the camera delegate.
Marcus: Great, let's keep an eye on it.

title: Staging Deployment & Docs Sync
transcript:
Alex Chen: PR #182 for Redis caching is approved.
Sarah: Nice. When is it going out?
Alex Chen: I'm on it, I will deploy the Redis caching PR to staging by Friday.
Sarah: Awesome. Count me in for updating the architecture documentation by end of next week.
Marcus: Perfect teamwork.

title: Monolith vs Microservices Debate
transcript:
Marcus: Quick discussion on whether to split the payments service into its own repo.
Sarah: I honestly think distributed transactions will give us way more headaches than benefits right now.
Alex Chen: But on the other hand our build times are creeping past 20 minutes in the monolith.
Priya: We could also look at Turborepo instead of multiple repos.
Marcus: We are clearly split on this. Let's table this entire topic for our quarterly offsite, no action items today.

title: Enterprise SSO Client Call
transcript:
Client CTO: We can only roll out ActionLoop if you support Okta SAML.
Marcus: We actually have SAML in beta right now.
Alex Chen: Yeah, I'll email you the Okta SAML configuration guide by tomorrow.
Client CTO: Can you also do SCIM provisioning?
Marcus: SCIM is on our Q1 roadmap, we can't promise a date just yet.

title: Database Deadlock Investigation
transcript:
Marcus: We had 4 deadlock errors logged in Postgres yesterday during checkout spikes.
Alex Chen: Let me circle back on the database deadlock logs and I will post an analysis report by Friday.
Marcus: Sounds good. Let Sarah know if you need query traces.

title: User Churn & Cancellation Survey
transcript:
Marcus: Month-over-month churn jumped 0.8% in the starter tier.
Sarah: We don't even ask users why they cancel right now.
Sarah: I will draft the cancellation exit survey questions in Google Docs by Thursday.
Elena: I'll review the question flow on Friday.

title: Sales Sandbox Environment
transcript:
Marcus: Sales team is demoing to Globex next week and needs dummy data.
Alex Chen: I'll spin up a seeded demo sandbox environment for Globex by next Tuesday.
Marcus: Great, make sure it has the new billing charts.

title: Settings Page Design Review
transcript:
Elena: The settings page layout is too cramped on smaller screens.
Elena: I will update the settings page responsive layout in Figma by tomorrow.
Priya: Ping me when done, I'll implement the CSS grid updates by Friday.

title: AWS Cloud Spend Spike
transcript:
Sarah: Our AWS bill was up $2,400 this month. Someone left 3 large EKS nodegroups running.
Sarah: I will shut down the orphaned development clusters today.
Marcus: Can we set up a hard spending limit?
Sarah: I'll configure AWS budget alert notifications by tomorrow.
negative_phrases: set up a hard spending limit

title: Penetration Testing Review
transcript:
Marcus: Security consultants sent over their external pen test findings.
Alex Chen: The only medium issue was wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the auth endpoint.
Alex Chen: I will restrict the CORS headers to approved origins by Friday.
Sarah: I'll review the updated Nginx ingress configuration by next Monday.
